_note: Single-source (Eastern Woodland: the Iroquois/Haudenosaunee). Woodland sub-palette of the North American family, Mohawk-Iroquoian register (which genuinely lacks labials). A confederacy of matrilineal longhouse clans bound by a Grand Council of sachems, the clan-mothers choosing and deposing the chiefs. clan = clanhold. Seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Iroquois register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.woodland), never real Iroquois gods.

phonology.palette: Mohawk-Iroquoian: NO labials (no p/b/m/f); consonants t k s h n r w y, ts, kw, hr, glottal stop '; vowels a e i o u with nasalization (en/on); long polysynthetic compounds; roots kanata (town), kanonhsa (longhouse), ononta (hill), kahyonha (river), ohwachira (clan).
phonology.phonotactics: CV(C); NO labials; glottal stops; nasal vowels; long compounds.

morphology.patronymic_form: the ohwachira (matrilineal clan) is named by an animal-totem; names belong to the clan and are bestowed (and recalled) by the clan-mother (Iakoia:ner); the 50 sachem-titles pass within their clans.
morphology.compounding_rule: long compounds: [quality|feature] + place: Onekwenhtara-karhakonha (red-forest), Kowanen-kaniatare (great-lake); clan-totem + -ronon.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (a confederacy of longhouse clans bound by a Grand Council of sachems; the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner) choose and may depose the chiefs; the Tadodaho presides over the council-fire; rule is by consensus - the Confederacy has no monarch)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Woodland clanhold, ascending; real Iroquois titles. Royaner (clan sachem) barony; Rotiskenrakehte (war chief, 'the carriers of the burden') march; Hoyaneh (village peace-chief) county; Tekarihoken (foremost sachem of a nation) duchy; Royaner Kowanen (great sachem) principality; Tadodaho (presiding firekeeper of the Grand Council) kingdom; Tadodaho Kowanen (presiding over the whole League) empire over the Haudenosaunee (the Confederacy, the great longhouse). The Confederacy has no monarch; the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner) raise and depose the chiefs, and rule is by council-consensus. (Rank titles are the real Iroquois register, allowed.)

female_forms._clan_mother: Iakoia:ner / Otiyaner (clan-mother - holds the sachem titles, chooses and deposes the chiefs)
female_forms.Tadodaho: (presiding office; the firekeeper is male, seated by the clan-mothers)

title_ladder.heir: Royaner-ase (the clan-mother's newly-raised sachem; titles are conferred within the clan, not inherited father-to-son)

people_name_convention.order: names belong to the ohwachira (matrilineal clan) and are held in trust, bestowed and recalled by the clan-mother (Iakoia:ner); the 50 sachem-titles pass within their clans (a new holder takes the title-name).
people_name_convention.dual_register: sachems bear the hereditary title-names of the Great Law; others a clan-held name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names favor the clan-totem animals and nature; the powers are invoked by domain rather than by name.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon in the Woodland register (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.woodland; labial-free, matching real Iroquoian), never real Iroquois gods. Shared pantheon, Woodland names. Oronan seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met at the rite-longhouse and the forest-grove; the council keeps the calendar of thanksgivings.
religion.the_one: Aterhonon (< Aeternus; the Sky-Holder-Above - revered as the upholder of the council's peace when Lawful, acknowledged but set aside when Neutral)

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tularonon (the sun, the day-keeper; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realwenne (the mother, the life-giver, clan-mother of the powers; honored)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aterhonon) and the Lawful powers (Tularonon, Oranhonon, Kayanonon, Nunaronon), demonize the Chaotic powers (Waraksonon, Wasidonon, Rusanonon)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the ancestral dead, the forest- and clan-spirits, and the thanksgivings to the growing things

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Chaotic powers, when Lawful) take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Waraksonon the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Wasidonon the Devourer; Lusanto -> Rusanonon the Greed-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: few god-houses - the rite-longhouse (kanonhses) of [power] and the forest-grove: 'the Kanonhses of Tularonon'; the thanksgiving-circle of the clans.
religion.saints_pattern: the founders of the council's peace and the honored clan-mothers and sachems, kept in the council's recital; honored at the rite-longhouse and the burial-grove.

holy_symbol_motifs.Realwenne: a sheltering mother over the planted field
holy_symbol_motifs.Kayanonon: a great oak rooted deep in the earth

banks_patterns.ships: forest river and lake craft - elm-bark and dugout canoe names: 'the Swift Heron', 'the River-Otter', 'Forest-Shadow'
banks_patterns.military_units: the war-parties: the [clan-totem] warriors / the [nation] war-band: 'the Wolf-clan warriors', 'the Hawk war-party'
banks_patterns.taverns: the longhouse, not the tavern: the council-longhouse / the [clan] longhouse: 'the Great Council-Longhouse', 'the Turtle Longhouse'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned palisade-castles and burial-groves: 'the empty Kanata of [name]', 'the Ghost-Longhouse of [clan]'
